_about: Speech lines for the vendor screens (ui/town/vendor_stage.gd). Key = Vendor Screen ID. open = said when the shop opens, buy = after a purchase, poor = when you cannot afford it, sold_out = when there is nothing left to sell. One is picked at random. Edit freely; add lines to any list.

open: Welcome, darling. Mind the glass. Everything in here has a history, and most of it is scandalous.
Ah, a customer with taste. Or at least a wallet. Let's find out which.
Look all you like. The misprints on the wall are not for sale. (They are, but you can't afford them.)
buy: Mmm. A pleasure doing business. Do tell your friends. Do not tell my competitors.
Sold! Treat her well. She has a past.
Excellent choice. I'd say I'm surprised, but I'm never surprised.
poor: Oh, sweetie. Come back when the purse is heavier.
Gold first, glamour second. That's the rule.

open: Welcome welcome WELCOME! Careful, the green one just got a bit... bouncy!
Oh! A customer! Don't mind the scorch mark, that was a Tuesday!
Everything on this shelf is tested! By me! Mostly on purpose!
buy: Great choice! Drink responsibly! Or at least in the right order!
Oooh, that's my favorite! Just... don't shake it. Okay, maybe a little shake.
Thank you thank you! Please bring back the bottle! Or what's left of it!
poor: Oops! Not enough gold! My hair is also blue today, so we're both disappointed!
Aww, a little short! Come back, I'll still be here! Probably!

open: State your business. Equipment is sorted by slot. Do not touch the drawer.
Welcome. Security protocol requires me to remind you that a beet is also a weapon. Do not ask me how.
Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant. Please do not call me the assistant. It is Assistant TO the Regional Merchant.
buy: Transaction logged. Equipment issued. Please sign nothing.
Acceptable. Fact: bears eat beets. Fact: I do not care for bears.
Purchase complete. Good gear is like a good beet: sturdy, earthy, and underappreciated.
poor: Insufficient funds. A discount is not a thing that exists here.
Denied. Return with gold. Or beets. Mostly gold.

open: Darling! A fresh canvas! Stand there. No, THERE. Don't move, I'm measuring.
Every hat tells a story. Yours is currently a short one. Let's fix that!
Try anything on! Everything! (Gasp.) Not that. Never that.
buy: Divine! You were born to wear it. Or at least to pay for it!
Oh, the drama! The silhouette! I could weep!
Wear it out. Turn heads. Tip the hat. Leave a legend.
poor: Oh, the tragedy! Fashion has a price, darling, and it is gold.
Not quite enough gold. Tragic. Come back, we'll make something of you yet.

open: Shh, shh, listen... can you hear that? That's the foil. It's whispering.
Welcome! Everything is sealed! Freshly sealed! Do you want to smell one? Just a sniff.
These pedestals are very sensitive. Do not breathe on the foil. Breathe near it. Politely.
buy: Ohhh, that one's a good pack. I can tell. Just by the... crinkle.
Foil! (Whispering.) Foil. Good luck. Please tell me what's inside.
Take it! Treat it gently! And if there's a shiny one, show me. I need to see.
poor: Oh no, oh no, not enough gold. I'll... I'll just hold the pack until you're back. Please come back.
A little short! A teeny bit! Come back and the foil will still be here. Probably.

open: Hello, dear. Pick two Paths and let the essence do the talking. It will, eventually.
The cauldron is warm today. It's been in a mood. Let's see what it makes of you.
Everything was healthiest when it was all mixed together. You'll see. They always do.
buy: Lovely. The flasks are pleased. They would say so, but flasks are rude.
Something new is born. Don't look so surprised. You did most of the work.
Mm, a fine blend. Mind the steam.
poor: Not enough essence or gold. The cauldron doesn't do charity. Neither do I.
Come back when you have more. It will keep. It's a cauldron.

open: Keep your voice down. The bookshelf listens. Pick something and let's pretend this never happened.
Psst. You didn't hear this from me, but everything here fell off a very nice cart.
Open the compartments. Slowly. The good stuff doesn't like being stared at.
buy: Pleasure. Never seen you before. That's the idea.
A discreet transaction. Stow it, quick, before the candle notices.
Smart. Rare goods don't wait. Neither do I.
poor: No coin, no contraband. Even a smuggler has to eat.
Short on gold? Then you're short on luck. Come back.

open: HEY, CHAMP! Welcome to the pro shop! Grab a tub, pick a card, get GAINS!
Rest day? NO SUCH THING. Browse the tubs, athlete!
Protein, pasteboard, and positive vibes! What are we lifting today?
buy: THAT'S WHAT I'M TALKING ABOUT! ONE MORE REP!
YEAH! Big move! Your deck just got JACKED!
BOOM! GAINS! Don't skip leg day! Or card day!
poor: Not enough gold, champ! Go win some fights, then come BACK STRONGER!
Short on coin? Cardio, then cash! GO!

open: Next. Please take a number. Please take a pen. Please do not take the stamp.
Welcome to Requisitions. Fill out the form. In triplicate. In ink. In the correct order.
The window is open. The window is, in fact, always open. The window has opinions on this.
buy: Approved. Filed. Re-filed. Please retain your receipt for the rest of your afterlife.
Processed. You will be contacted. You will not be contacted. Both are normal.
Stamped. It is now official. Nothing can undo it, except Form 12-B, which we are out of.
poor: Application denied. Insufficient funds. See Form 12-C.
Your gold does not meet the minimum. Please return with more gold, in triplicate.

open: Bonsoir, mon cher. Tonight's menu is a selection of cards, presented as nature intended: under a lid.
Ah, a guest. Please, sit. Or stand and hover. We are not too formal.
Each card is plated with great care. Lift the cloche and appreciate. Do not poke.
buy: Exquisite. A fine pairing with whatever you were planning. Bon appétit.
Magnifique. May it serve you well. And may it never be overcooked.
Merci. I will have it boxed. By which I mean I will hand it to you directly.
poor: Alas, the bill exceeds your purse. A tragedy in three courses.
Non, non. Insufficient funds. Come back when your wallet is plump.

open: Well, look what the compost dragged in. Pull up a stump, sugar, and dig around.
Everything in the cans is tried and true. Some of it's even clean. Ish.
Don't mind the raccoons. They rummage, but they pay in loose change.
buy: Ha! Good pickin'! That one was in the third can. Took me a week to find.
Sold to the one with sense. Mind the rust, it adds character.
There ya go, sugar. One man's trash is another man's trump card.
poor: Ain't enough gold in that pocket, sugar. Go scrounge some more.
Short a few coins, honey. Rummage somewhere else, then come back.

open: LADIES AND GENTLEBEINGS! THE CHALLENGERS ARE ASSEMBLED! THE PRIZES ARE POLISHED! STEP UP TO THE BOOTH!
WELCOME BACK, CHAMPION! THE CROWD IS RESTLESS AND I AM MID-LUNCH! CHOOSE YOUR FIGHT!
THE GRAND CLASHATORIUM IS OPEN FOR BUSINESS! PICK YOUR BOUT!
buy: A MAGNIFICENT CHOICE! THE CROWD GOES WILD!
AND THE CHALLENGER STEPS FORWARD! HEAR THEM ROAR!
poor: THAT BOUT IS NOT YET YOURS! COME BACK STRONGER!
A LOCKED DOOR, CHAMPION! CLEAR MORE ZONES!
